- **Sound and HDR sort themselves out.** SlopFin now reads which formats your
  TV, receiver or headset accepts and picks the best path for every track:
  Dolby and DTS go to your receiver when it lists them, so Atmos reaches your
  speakers; otherwise the PS5 decodes them, including TrueHD, or Jellyfin
  converts them. A TV that can't take DTS no longer plays silence.
- **Dolby Vision** files (profiles 7 and 8.1) always play from their HDR10
  picture on the PS5 instead of your server converting the whole 4K video.
- **Settings → Audio/Video is down to one choice**, Surround sound: Automatic,
  or Decode on PS5 for a receiver that plays Dolby or DTS silently or out of
  sync. The page shows what your TV or receiver accepts. The PS5 audio
  decoding and Dolby Vision switches are gone: they're always on now.
- **Automatic fallback.** If decoding or the Dolby Vision picture fails on a
  title, or the TV refuses the sound, SlopFin restarts it where it stopped
  with that part handled another way, instead of stopping with an error.

- **Sign-in waits for you.** Finishing the password on the keyboard no longer
  signs in straight away; press **Sign in** when you're ready.
- **Settings look tidier:** page content no longer runs onto the dark sidebar,
  and Back is a Circle prompt at the bottom right.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
